title: An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge for LLM Evaluation: Fine-tuned Judge Model is not a General Substitute for GPT-4
reasoning: While the study evaluates models on safety and toxicity benchmarks (SALAD-Bench and ToxicChat) and discusses fairness, it does so to demonstrate the generalizability limitations and classifier-like behavior of fine-tuned judge models. It does not focus on or primarily benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
